phase_name: Port the gate body with the corrected matcher into the researched and planning handlers

objectives.description: Insert H4 gate into researched handler before skill_preflight_update
Insert identical H4 gate into planning handler
Verify both insertions byte-identical and patterns match Phase 1 verbatim

approaches_tried.approach: Combined hard_mode and adversarial_verified conditions into one if statement (if [ hard_mode ] && [ adversarial_verified=false ]) rather than nesting two separate if blocks
approaches_tried.reason: Functionally equivalent to nesting; matches this same file's own established multi-condition if-statement style used elsewhere (e.g. Stage 5b). Also had to wrap the entire remainder of each handler (skill_preflight_update through the team_mode dispatch) in a second outer if, closing with a second 'fi', since falling through to skill_preflight_update or the planning Agent dispatch after a re-dispatch would be incorrect -- the -hard engine achieves the same effect via two sequential top-level if-blocks.
